newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Quinn says leaders must agree pact figures.
newsitem.headline: Quinn says leaders must agree pact figures.

text.p: Irish Finance Minister Ruairi Quinn said on Friday that European Union leaders would have to agree figures for defining when countries with excessive deficits in a single currency would be exempt from fines.
"We have decided to put square brackets around those figures. We have an agreement except with reference to a series of numbers," he told reporters after an EU finance ministers meeting.

Minister had proposed that countries be exempt from fines if their economies contracted by 1.5 percent. Countries could make special pleas for leniency if their economies fell by less than that but more than 0.75 percent, according to the proposal.
